texts.facts: In this case, a Detailed Accident Report (hereinafter referred as DAR) was filed by police official concerned and in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act, same is treated as Claim Petition under Section 166 (1) read with Section 166 (4) MV Act. It pertains to alleged accident of injured Azad (hereinafter referred as claimant), by offending vehicle bearing Reg. No. HR 29S 4501, driven by Rahul Chauhan (hereinafter referred as R-1), owned by B. S. Chauhan, (hereinafter referred as R-2) and Insured with National Insurance Company Limited (hereinafter referred as R-3). 2. Preliminary information regarding accident in question was received at PS Jaitpur vide DD No. 6A dated 26.011.2018. Upon receipt of which police officials namely ASI Dharambir and Constable Manoj reached the spot of accident where they found a Motorcycle bearing Reg. No. DL 3SDX 5467 and Car no. HR 29S 4501 in accidental condition. It came to light that the motorcyclist got hit by offending vehicle and was already removed to hospital. Police officials however found the driver of the said offending vehicle on the spot. Subsequently, MLC of injured was collected from Apollo Hospital and statement of injured was recorded who narrated that he lived in Madanpur Khadar with his family and was employed as helper on the MACT No.336/2019 Azad Vs. Rahul Chauhan & Ors. Page No. 2 of 26 :3 : garbage vehicle of SDMC. He explained how his motorcycle bearing Reg. No. DL 3SDX 5467 was hit by offending vehicle coming from front side while on his way from Madanpur Khadar to Mithapur with great force due to which he sustained injury and his motorcycle also got damaged. After some time, his mother reached the spot. The driver of offending vehicle called PCR and sent me along with my mother to hospital. FIR was registered on the basis of statement of injured under Section 279/337 IPC. Both the accidental vehicles were taken into possession and got mechanically examined. Site plan was prepared. IO recorded the statement of witnesses under section 161 CrPC. Driver of offending vehicle was arrested. Upon completion investigation, charge-sheet was filed under Sections 279/338 IPC before concerned MM against driver Rahul. DAR was filed by Investigating Officer before this Tribunal. 3. In response to DAR, driver and owner did not file their reply and their right to file reply was closed on 01.08.2019. 4. Insurance Company has filed its reply/ legal offer and it is admitted that it has no statutory defence however, it asserted Azad (Dar) vs Rahul Chauhan (754/18Jp) on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66686736/ 2 contributory negligence on the part of injured as the accident was head on collision and victim was also not having valid DL at the time of accident. 5. From the pleadings of parties, following issues were framed vide order dated 01.08.2019: i). iii). Relief. 6. Perusal of record shows that directions were issued for assessment of disability certificate and matter was listed for recording of evidence of petitioner. 7. Perusal of the record reflect that application seeking assessment of disability was allowed vide order dated 01.08.2018. It is not put on record that victim even appeared before any Medical Board for getting disability assessed. Further, issues were framed in this matter on the same date but after 5 years, evidence has not been even commenced. There is not even a single submissions by counsel for petitioner on any date that he ever appeared before Disability Board for any assessment. For reasons mentioned in order dated 12.01.2024, PE was closed. 8. As no one was appearing on behalf of R-1 & 2 for several dates of hearing and even as they ever failed to file reply to DAR to contest the matter or to put up any defence, their opportunity to lead RE was closed vide order dated 12.01.2024. Even Counsel for R-3/ Insurance Company chose not to lead any RE.
